checkedAlternates.risk: Ecuador uses the US Dollar, which is free-floating.
checkedAlternates.resolution: As a national regime, Ecuador’s system has no separate domestic legal tender (group-1), distinct from the Federal Reserve’s free-floating USD (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: The Danish Krone is tightly stabilized against the Euro.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Denmark operates a conventional narrow-band ERM II peg rather than a 100%-backed statutory currency board (group-2).
